latest.title: An Anisotropic Onsager Criterion for the Two-Dimensional Navier--Stokes Equations with Horizontal Viscosity
latest.abstract: We consider distributional weak solutions $u\in L^\infty_tL^2_x$ of the two-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations with horizontal viscosity on $\mathbb T^2$ or $\mathbb R^2$, without assuming $\partial_1u\in L^2_tL^2_x$. We show that the Lions integrability condition $u\in L^4_tL^4_x$ together with Onsager-critical regularity in the nondissipative direction, $u\in L^3_tB^{1/3,v}_{3,\infty}$ with the Besov regularity imposed only in the vertical direction, implies $\partial_1u\in L^2_tL^2_x$, with a quantitative bound on the horizontal dissipation. Thus the dissipative regularity is a consequence of the equation and need not be part of the definition of the solution. If moreover $u\in L^3_tB^{1/3,v}_{3,c_0}$, then $u$ belongs to the isotropic critical Onsager space $L^3_tB^{1/3}_{3,c_0}$, satisfies the energy equality, and is continuous in $L^2$. Here $c_0$ indicates that the corresponding dyadic Besov sequence tends to zero at high frequencies. The proof combines absorption of the horizontal energy flux into the dissipation with a one-dimensional commutator estimate for the vertical energy flux.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究仅在水平变量耗散的二维 Navier–Stokes 弱解，证明 $u\in L^4_tL^4_x$ 与垂直方向临界 Besov 正则性会反推出水平耗散 $\partial _1u\in L^2_{t,x}$；若垂直 Besov 序列属于 $c_0$，还可得到各向同性临界能量等式。
latest.breakthrough: 给出只要求非耗散方向 1/3 阶 Besov 正则性的 Onsager 判据，并证明耗散正则性是方程推论而非定义假设。
latest.limitations: 结论限于二维、水平黏性和分布解；低于临界正则性、三维或非局部边界情形未处理。

steps.claim: Lemma 3.3–3.10 将垂直增量和各向异性 Besov 范数转成三次能量通量界。
steps.route: 对垂直变量作 dyadic increment，利用一维 Besov 嵌入得到 $L^3$ 控制；Littlewood–Paley 截断把非线性通量拆成低–高频三项，各项分别由 $u\in L^4L^4$ 和垂直 1/3 正则性估计。

steps.claim: Lemma 4.1 的一维交换子估计控制垂直能量通量的临界极限。
steps.route: 将垂直平移差商与 mollifier 的卷积交换，先把通量写成差分三重积，再用 Hölder 和 $B^{1/3}_{3,\infty }$ 半范数取得尺度无关界$；c_0$ 条件使高频尾趋零。

steps.claim: Propositions 4.2–4.3 将水平通量吸收到黏性耗散并推出能量等式。
steps.route: 对截断方程测试 u，水平高频通量由 Young 不等式分出 $\nu ||\partial _1u||^{2}$ 的一半，剩余项由 Lemma 4.1 控制；截断尺度趋零后得到 $\partial _1u\in L^{2}，c_0$ 情形进一步使全部通量消失。
